title.ur: Indoor coil / evaporator ka temperature zyada

meaning.en: Evaporator pipe temperature above 63 °C (service manual wording). Often normal protection: outdoor fan stops while 53 °C<T<63 °C; code shows above 63 °C; restarts below 49 °C. Also reported as indoor coil temperature sensor error on consumer guides.
meaning.ur: Evaporator pipe ka temperature 63 °C se upar ho to code aata hai (service manual ki wording). Aksar yeh normal protection hai: 53 °C se kam aur 63 °C se upar ke darmiyan outdoor fan ruk jata hai; code 63 °C se upar nazar aata hai; 49 °C se neeche aate hi unit dobara chalti hai. Consumer guides par isay indoor coil temperature sensor error bhi kaha jata hai.

causes.ur: Normal over-temperature protection (coil garam ho jate hain)
Indoor coil temperature sensor dheela hai
Indoor coil temperature sensor kharab hai
Indoor control board kharab hai

solutions.en: Let coil cool; unit restarts below 49 °C (self-clear)
solutions.ur: Coil ko thanda hone dein; 49 °C se neeche aate hi unit khud restart ho jati hai
Indoor coil sensor dobara lagayein ya badlein

solutions.en: Replace indoor control board if needed
solutions.ur: Zaroorat ho to indoor control board badlein

meaning.en: EEPROM/settings on control board failed self-check twice.
meaning.ur: Control board ke EEPROM/settings ne khud check do baar fail kiya.

causes.ur: EEPROM chip dheela ya corrupted hai
Control board ki memory circuit kharab hai

solutions.en: Switch the AC off at the breaker and wait a few minutes before opening the panel, so the board is fully discharged.
solutions.ur: AC ko breaker se band karke panel kholne se pehle kuch minute intezaar karein taake board poori tarah discharge ho jaye.

solutions.en: Power-cycle once from the breaker; if EE returns, open the control board and reseat the EEPROM chip in its correct orientation.
solutions.ur: Breaker se ek dafa power cycle karein; agar EE wapas aaye to control board khol kar EEPROM chip sahi direction mein dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: If the code still returns after reseating, the EEPROM data is corrupted — technician should reprogram it or replace the control board.
solutions.ur: Agar chip dobara lagane ke baad bhi code aaye to EEPROM data kharab hai — technician ise dobara program kare ya control board badlein.

title.ur: Indoor sensor open circuit (family ke mutabiq)

meaning.en: On classic splits often indoor temperature sensor open circuit / indoor sensor fault; T1 floor-standing F0 is wired-remote EEPROM (different series). Some lines: refrigerant shortage (quarantined single-source hvacinexpert).
meaning.ur: Classic splits par aam tor par indoor temperature sensor ka open circuit ya indoor sensor ki fault hoti hai; T1 floor-standing par F0 wired-remote EEPROM hai (alag series). Kuch lines: refrigerant ki kami (quarantined single-source hvacinexpert).

causes.en: Indoor temperature sensor disconnected or damaged
causes.ur: Indoor temperature sensor disconnect hai ya toot gaya hai
Sensor tak ki wiring open hai

solutions.en: Turn the unit off at the breaker and remove the panel cover before probing any sensor wiring.
solutions.ur: Unit ko breaker se band karke panel cover utaarein, phir koi bhi sensor wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Follow the sensor lead to the indoor coil and reseat its connector; check the cable for breaks with a visual look and a continuity meter.
solutions.ur: Sensor ki wire indoor coil tak le jayein aur connector dobara lagayein; wire ko nazar se dekh kar aur continuity meter se tootne ka check karein.

solutions.en: If the circuit stays open, measure the sensor resistance at room temperature; replace the indoor temperature sensor if the reading is out of range, otherwise technician checks the board input.
solutions.ur: Agar circuit phir bhi open rahe to room temperature par sensor ki resistance naapein; reading range se bahar ho to indoor temperature sensor badlein, warna technician board input check kare.

title.ur: Voltage zyada ya km ki protection (export family)

meaning.en: Mains voltage out of allowed window → protection trip. (T1 wired-remote FE is a different meaning — see t1 series.)
meaning.ur: Mains voltage ijazat range se bahar jaane par protection chalti hai. (T1 wired-remote FE ka matlab alag hai — t1 series dekhein.)

causes.en: Supply voltage too high or too low
causes.ur: Supply voltage bohat zyada ya bohat kam hai
Mains ka connection dheela hai

solutions.en: Do not restart the unit; measure the mains voltage at the outlet with a multeter before anything else.
solutions.ur: Unit dobara restart na karein; sabse pehle multimeter se outlet par mains voltage naapein.

solutions.en: Compare the reading with the voltage range on the rating label; if it is too high or too low, correct the supply or fit a stabilizer.
solutions.ur: Reading ko rating label ke voltage range se milayein; bohat zyada ya kam ho to supply theek karein ya stabilizer lagayein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle from the breaker and check the mains wiring terminals for looseness; if the voltage still drifts, call the supply authority or a technician.
solutions.ur: Breaker se power cycle karein aur mains wiring ke terminals ki tightness check karein; voltage idhar-udhar hota rahe to bijli wale ya technician ko bulayein.
